name: nava-suite
description: NAVA's 15 specialized MCP servers (spec 3.3): files, terminal, python, processes, system, screen, gui, clipboard, apps, notify, web, browser, memory, bus, plans. Each tool forwards to the NAVA gateway (runtime-os), where the 12-step managed syscall — classification, policy, approvals, quotas, locks, snapshot/rollback, receipt — happens exactly once; the facade adds no risk of its own (spec 3.2: classification is single-sourced).
endpoint: /<domain>/mcp (all 15 mounted by `revenueos-mcp-nava all`, compose service nava-mcp)

nava-terminal: run  (the OpenMuse isolated terminal: bwrap sandbox, 30 s hard cap, no host mounts)

tools.description: Declared low at the facade; real risk is classified and enforced per call by the NAVA gateway (critical blocks in every mode, high needs a hash-bound approval).
